applied_after: COLLECTION_COMPLETE and technical-validity review, before opening any post-action scientific outcome
reason: The preregistered analysis implementation would have mapped fewer than eight usable blocks to NO_STABLE_ACTION_EFFECT. The protocol instead requires CONFIRMATORY_EXPERIMENT_TECHNICALLY_INCOMPLETE when the planned two-target data are technically insufficient.
uniform_rule: Run the frozen endpoints only on blocks already marked COLLECTED.
